verdict.rationale: A state business registry holds an entity's filing records, so data portability is a fair question. The agency's own entity search lets users "obtain PDFs of many of the entity filings" and print good-standing certificates, giving document-level retrieval in a widely readable format. There is no bulk export of all data, no structured or machine-readable open formats, and no documented API (the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes returned 404). Leaving is only implied by a FAQ title on continuation versus domestication. missing for 10: bulk export of all entity data, structured open formats (CSV/JSON), coverage of all filings rather than "many", documented exit/transfer workflow, independent corroboration.
